title: Make Phoenix preparation and test dependencies work with only the .NET 10 toolchain
outcome: A fresh host can prepare/build/test Phoenix with .NET10 without separately installing older framework/SDK packs; preserve meaningful semantic behavior coverage and explicitly report legacy-target coverage consequences.
acceptance: Inventory production/test targets and distinguish incidental fixture targets from dedicated legacy compatibility coverage; record an independent design consultation before meaningful implementation.
Update preparation, fixture dependencies and matching repository instructions for the approved .NET10-only setup, with no silent newer-reference substitution or skipped failing tests.
Run the complete automated gate on the final change set and complete independent dual review; report the exact effect on legacy-framework compatibility tests and any remaining prerequisites.
